text:
sarah.ng: Quick check — before we open the new APAC on-prem cluster request: do we have clarity on vendor's eviction/maintenance windows for their H100 nodes? Need to know whether we can mix preemptible A100s for non-critical loads.

raj.patel: We have an estimate from the vendor but not the SLA doc. They mentioned maintenance windows that are CET-friendly which is painful for APAC. Pinging vendor for written schedule and preemption semantics.

procurement-bot: PO SUP-4521 submitted to VendorX, est provisioning ETA 14 business days.

vendor-contact-aliya: Hi team — confirmation: for on-prem racks in the SIN site, H100 nodes have 2x planned maintenance windows/month (UTC 02:00-03:00) and an optional emergency firmware hold that can cause ~30m reboots. We can provide NBD exceptions under contract if you need stricter windows.

emma: Can we get that emergency firmware hold matrix in writing? We need to decide fallback policy (route to hosted / dedicated) during reboots.

sarah.ng: Yes please. Also what's the preemption behavior — can vendor mark A100s as preemptible with a 2-min warning API webhook? We'd like to drain workloads before eviction.

vendor-contact-aliya: A100 preemption: yes, webhook + gRPC signal, 120s. We'll provide example endpoint and HMAC token. I'll attach sample payload and signature example.

kai: For scheduling, note that UTC 02:00-03:00 is 10:00-11:00 SGT — that'll hit our APAC support overlap. Suggest we ask them to shift to UTC 20:00-22:00 if possible, or at least do rolling reboots.

raj.patel: Noted. Also we need to reserve quota — what's the exact inventory numbers? Sarah, what's the target pool size so I can include it in the ticket?

sarah.ng: Initial request: 12 H100 (prod) + 24 A100 preemptible (batch). If vendor can't shift maintenance, request rolling upgrade schedule so not all H100s reboot in same window.

vendor-contact-aliya: We can do rolling reboots across racks (stagger by rack). Please provide rack IDs and preferred concurrency (e.g., 1 rack at a time).

sarah.ng: OK. Next actions: raj to open/annotate quota ticket with vendor quoting SUP-4521 and request rolling reboot schedule + webhook endpoint. Raj, can you do that?

raj.patel: I'll open the ticket now. Command I'm using to capture node labels for our on-prem kube cluster (to attach to the request):
```bash
kubectl get nodes -L cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool,accelerator --no-headers\```
I'll attach the output and the preferred rack list.

emma: Thanks. Once ticket is up, tag me and Kai. I'll prepare our fallback router config to fail over to dedicated pool (route weight -> 0.0 for impacted model routes) during reboots and test draining.

sarah.ng: One last thing — any constraints on KMS/HSM integration for the private nodes? Vendor said KMS can be customer-managed but HSM firmware needs approval.

vendor-contact-aliya: Correct — HSM firmware approval required; that's handled via contract amendment. We'll add a clause and speed up approval for your PO.

procurement-bot: Ticket SUP-4521 updated by raj.patel at 2100009922: vendor requested rack IDs, rolling policy preference, and PO reference.

raj.patel: Done @vendor-contact-aliya — racks list sent and concurrency requested = 1 rack at a time. Will update here once vendor confirms schedule. :eyes:
